title: IdeaIntakeItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-idea-intake, nested inside the standard AgentOutput envelope (schemas/agent-output-schema.json). There is no separate idea-brief.md document — this agent produces no artifact. 'statement' fields here ARE the full, authoritative content (the complete problem statement, the complete value proposition, each target user's complete description), grounded via traced_to — not a distillation of something fuller stored elsewhere. Structured/classificatory fields (ids, status, confidence) are likewise kept in full. No citation objects — this agent grounds against the raw input text, not a knowledge base, so each item carries traced_to (the input excerpt supporting it) instead of a KB citation.

statement.description: The full statement text (no separate idea-brief.md document exists — this field IS the authoritative record), grounded via traced_to

reasoning.description: Why this was extracted/synthesized this way

traced_to.description: The specific input excerpt this is grounded in

statement.description: The full description of this target user segment (no separate idea-brief.md document exists — this field IS the authoritative record), grounded via traced_to

metric.description: Metric names are already short — not narrative prose, kept in full

status.description: stated = explicit in input; suggested = inferred, must read 'suggested — pending stakeholder validation' downstream

question.description: Already a short, self-contained question — not narrative prose, kept in full

reasoning.description: Why this is unresolved from the input as given
